description: Configuration for the protagonist's private system. This file says how the system WORKS. engine/system-status.json says where the protagonist currently IS. Doctrine and pacing rationale live in engine/system-engine.md.

system.name: the Tally
system.in_world_name: unnamed — the protagonist has never had a word for it
system.premise: Everything that ends sheds what it was. The owner alone can see the residue and take it.

physical.strength: force applied, and force absorbed without breaking
physical.agility: speed of the whole body through space
physical.reflex: speed of the decision before the body moves
physical.constitution: what the body tolerates: damage, poison, exhaustion, essence load

mental.perception: what is noticed, including essence, intent, and flaw
mental.comprehension: how fast an unfamiliar pattern becomes a usable one
mental.will: what holds when the body and the nerve have both quit
mental.spirit: capacity to hold and drive essence and patterns

rare.fortune: the thumb on the scale; rises almost never (LK-ESSENCE-FINITE applies — someone else's luck is worse)
rare.affinity: how readily the world's essence answers this specific person

raise_cost_rule.formula: cost to go from v to v+1 = 1 + floor(v / 10)
raise_cost_rule.note: Cheap early, punishing later. Reaching 50 in one attribute costs 150 points; reaching 100 costs 550.
raise_cost_rule.rare_note: fortune and affinity cost five times as much, and the engine refuses to raise fortune without --override.

mote_tiers.name: dim
mote_tiers.typical_source: a mortal's day of labour, a snapped tool

mote_tiers.name: clear
mote_tiers.typical_source: a Tempering cultivator's hard training, a common beast

mote_tiers.name: bright
mote_tiers.typical_source: a Kindling death, a refined-grade item destroyed

mote_tiers.name: radiant
mote_tiers.typical_source: a Nexus death, a failed profound forging

mote_tiers.name: resplendent
mote_tiers.typical_source: an Aperture death, a heavenly-grade ruin

mote_tiers.name: sovereign
mote_tiers.grants: a trait state, a talent step, or a technique at Origin band — never raw points
mote_tiers.typical_source: a Sovereign's remains, an origin-grade relic, a place where something enormous ended

ambient_training.label: the shed effort of others training nearby
ambient_training.note: The signature source and the moral engine. He profits from labour that was not his. Name who paid (LK-MOTE-COSTS).

broken_object.label: a vessel, blade, or array at the moment it fails

failed_craft.label: a forging, batch, or inscription that failed
failed_craft.note: Why he haunts workshops. Failure is more generous than success, which is its own theme.

spent_consumable.label: a pill, talisman, or elixir as it is used up

ruin.label: places where something ended long ago

insight.label: watching a master work at the edge of their ability
insight.note: Yields proficiency and comprehension, rarely raw points.

corpse_old.label: remains that have been dead a long time

familiarity_decay.note: Multiplier = decay ^ (times already absorbed from that class, this realm). Grinding the same source stops paying. A breakthrough opens the frontier again.

caps.note: Soft cap warns. Hard cap refuses without --override and a logged reason. These are the anti-inflation rail.

absorption_rules.witness_rule: An absorption is only real if it happened in a scene. The engine requires a --scene note and records the chapter.

thresholds.effect: sleep goes wrong; perception of essence starts to smear at the edges
essence circulation stutters under strain; -1 effective constitution in any long fight
a deviation event is due, on the page, at the worst available time
the next absorption of any kind triggers it

purge.alchemy: a Rank 4+ cleansing pill removes 20-30, and costs a fortune or a favour
purge.cooking: a Rank 3+ cook removes 8-12 with no toxicity, slowly, and requires trusting someone
purge.time: 1 per chapter of genuine rest, which the tempo rarely allows

proficiency.note: Proficiency may be raised with points, but band changes above 'fluent' must be earned in a scene, not bought.

talents.note: Talent is rate, not power. It is publicly assessed on record, which is why the Tally's results are inexplicable to everyone who knows his ratings.

realms.name: Tempering
realms.on_page: Nine gates, nine separate refusals to stop.

realms.name: Kindling
realms.on_page: Essence ignites. It is survivable and it is not private — someone always feels it.

realms.name: Nexus
realms.on_page: The seat forms or it does not. Failure cripples.

realms.name: Aperture
realms.on_page: The body opens to the world. What is nearby comes in, including what he would rather not hold.

traits.name: Iron-Marrow
traits.gift: bone density and shock tolerance rise sharply; +constitution scaling with state
traits.toll: the body stops reporting damage accurately
traits.trigger: a bone broken and used anyway, under essence load

traits.name: Hollow-Ear
traits.gift: hears essence move, through walls and through lies
traits.toll: cannot filter it; crowds and cities are agony
traits.trigger: prolonged proximity to a silenced formation

traits.name: Thousand-Coin
traits.gift: abnormal fortune in small things, compounding
traits.toll: the luck is conserved and taken from someone nearby, always someone known

traits.name: Kiln-Blood
traits.gift: tolerates heat and reagent toxicity that would kill a peer; the great alchemist trait
traits.toll: cannot be healed by ordinary medicine; everything must be earned twice

traits.name: Null-Weave
traits.toll: their own sorcery fails too, and cultivators find them unsettling without knowing why
traits.trigger: standing inside a collapsing array and refusing to leave

professions.certification_rule: Each rank requires a certification piece made under observation. Failure is public and expensive.
professions.build_rule: Every 10 proficiency in a profession grants 1 point to one of its 'builds' attributes, chosen on the page.
